journey.title: Learn It
journey.studentText: Today we will learn about fractions. A fraction is a part of a whole. A half (1/2) means one of two equal parts.
journey.owlText: Here is what you need to know.

journey.title: Real Life Connection
journey.studentText: Where do you see 1/2 and 1/4 at home or school?
journey.owlText: We use this knowledge every day!

journey.title: Watch and Learn
journey.studentText: Let me show you how 1/2 and 1/4 works. Follow along!
journey.owlText: Watch this example, then you will try.

journey.title: Your Turn!
journey.studentText: Practice: Draw a circle and shade half. Draw a rectangle and shade a quarter.
journey.owlText: Great effort! Keep practicing.

journey.title: Quick Check!
journey.studentText: What is a half?
journey.owlText: Choose the best answer.

interaction.question: What is a half?
interaction.explanation: Correct! A half is one of two equal parts.

journey.title: Think About Learning
journey.studentText: What did you learn about 1/2 and 1/4 today? Write your answer below.
journey.owlText: You worked hard today!

interaction.prompt: What did you learn?

journey.title: Well Done!
journey.studentText: Congratulations! You completed the lesson about 1/2 and 1/4!
journey.owlText: Excellent work today!
